ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $AB$ is the diameter of $\odot O$, $M$ is a point on $AB$, and $OA=6$, $AM=2$. The chord $PQ$ passes through point $M$, and the minor arc $PQ$ is folded along the chord $PQ$ to just pass through the center $O$. What is the length of $PM$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Draw OF $\perp$ PQ at point N, intersecting circle O at point F,\\
$\therefore$ PN=QN, $\because$ the minor arc PQ folds along the chord PQ to exactly pass through the center O, $\therefore$ ON=$\frac{1}{2}$OF=$\frac{1}{2}$OQ=3,\\
$\because$ AM=2, $\therefore$ OM=OA−AM=6−2=4,\\
$\therefore$ QN=PN=$\sqrt{OQ^{2}−ON^{2}}=\sqrt{6^{2}−3^{2}}=3\sqrt{3}$,\\
$\therefore$ MN=$\sqrt{OM^{2}−ON^{2}}=\sqrt{4^{2}−3^{2}}=\sqrt{7}$,\\
$\therefore$ PM=PN−MN=$3\sqrt{3}−\sqrt{7}$. Thus, the answer is: $PM=\boxed{3\sqrt{3}−\sqrt{7}}$.

method.method_draft: First read the figure: M is an interior point on diameter AB, chord PQ passes through M, and P is the closer endpoint to M on the lower-left side while Q is farther on the upper side. From the text, OA=6 gives radius R=6 and AM=2 gives OM=4. Use the folding condition to conclude that the distance from O to chord PQ is 3: the fold line PQ is the perpendicular bisector of the segment joining O to its preimage point on the circle. Therefore the full chord length is PQ=2sqrt(R^2-3^2)=2sqrt(36-9)=6sqrt(3). Now avoid computing MN: apply the power of point M with respect to the circle. Since M lies inside the circle and PQ is a secant through M, MP·MQ=R^2-OM^2=36-16=20. Let MP=x. Then MQ=PQ-MP=6sqrt(3)-x, so x(6sqrt(3)-x)=20. Solving gives x=3sqrt(3)±sqrt(7). The image shows P is the nearer endpoint to M, so take the smaller root: PM=3sqrt(3)-sqrt(7).

solver_metadata.cot_raw: 图像描述：附图显示一个圆，AB 是水平直径，O 在圆心，M 位于 AB 上且在 O 的左侧；一条斜弦 PQ 从左下方的 P 经过 M 延伸到上方的 Q，图中 P 是离 M 较近的端点，Q 离 M 较远；虚线弧和弯曲线表示小弧 PQ 沿弦 PQ 折叠后经过圆心 O。推理：OA=6，所以圆半径 R=6。AM=2，且 A、M、O 在直径 AB 上，因此 OM=OA−AM=6−2=4。由折叠条件，弦 PQ 是圆心 O 与其折叠对应点连线的垂直平分线，因此 O 到弦 PQ 的距离为半径的一半，即 3。于是弦长 PQ=2√(R^2−3^2)=2√(36−9)=6√3。用点 M 关于圆的幂：MP·MQ=R^2−OM^2=36−16=20。设 MP=x，则因为 M 在 P、Q 之间，MQ=PQ−MP=6√3−x，所以 x(6√3−x)=20。解得 x=3√3±√7。图中 P 是较近端点，所以取较小根，PM=3√3−√7。

raw_record.original_question: As shown in the figure, $AB$ is the diameter of $\odot O$, $M$ is a point on $AB$, and $OA=6$, $AM=2$. The chord $PQ$ passes through point $M$, and the minor arc $PQ$ is folded along the chord $PQ$ to just pass through the center $O$. What is the length of $PM$?
raw_record.answer:
\textbf{Solution:} Draw OF $\perp$ PQ at point N, intersecting circle O at point F,\\
$\therefore$ PN=QN, $\because$ the minor arc PQ folds along the chord PQ to exactly pass through the center O, $\therefore$ ON=$\frac{1}{2}$OF=$\frac{1}{2}$OQ=3,\\
$\because$ AM=2, $\therefore$ OM=OA−AM=6−2=4,\\
$\therefore$ QN=PN=$\sqrt{OQ^{2}−ON^{2}}=\sqrt{6^{2}−3^{2}}=3\sqrt{3}$,\\
$\therefore$ MN=$\sqrt{OM^{2}−ON^{2}}=\sqrt{4^{2}−3^{2}}=\sqrt{7}$,\\
$\therefore$ PM=PN−MN=$3\sqrt{3}−\sqrt{7}$. Thus, the answer is: $PM=\boxed{3\sqrt{3}−\sqrt{7}}$.
raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: The figure shows a circle with horizontal diameter AB, center O on AB, and point M on AB between A and O. A slanted chord PQ passes through M, with P on the lower-left part of the circle and Q near the top. The drawing also shows a folded/dashed arc associated with arc PQ, indicating the arc is folded across chord PQ and passes through O.

Reasoning: Since OA=6, the radius of the circle is 6. Also AM=2 and A, M, O are collinear with M between A and O, so OM=OA-AM=6-2=4. Draw ON perpendicular to chord PQ at N, and extend ON to meet the circle at F on the minor-arc side. Folding the minor arc PQ along chord PQ so that it passes through O means O is the reflection of a point F on the circle across line PQ. Therefore PQ is the perpendicular bisector of OF, so N is the midpoint of OF. Since F lies on the circle centered at O, OF=6, hence ON=3. The perpendicular from the center to a chord bisects the chord, so PN=QN. In right triangle OQN, QN=sqrt(OQ^2-ON^2)=sqrt(6^2-3^2)=sqrt(27)=3sqrt(3), hence PN=3sqrt(3). In right triangle OMN, MN=sqrt(OM^2-ON^2)=sqrt(4^2-3^2)=sqrt(7). From the figure, M lies between P and N on chord PQ, so PM=PN-MN=3sqrt(3)-sqrt(7).
